en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a waterfront street with tram tracks running along a quay. On the left are multi‑storey European‑style buildings with shops and balconies; on the right are piers with docked ships and masts. The caption identifies the scene as the quays and new railroad area of Salonique (Thessaloniki). There is printed text in French and English along the bottom margin and a website watermark across the lower right.
